name: platsbanken-mcp
description: Platsbanken (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Arbetsförmedlingen JobSearch API v1.37 (Swagger at https://jobsearch.api.jobtechdev.se/swagger.json): q = 'Freetext query. Search in ad headline, ad description and employer name', offset 'Valid range is (0-2000)', limit 'Valid range is (0-100)', remote 'True will return ads which are likely to allow remote work'. municipality/region/country take JobTech taxonomy codes, so location and country are not sent — put the place name in query instead. The getting-started guide asks for a key to use the Swagger GUI, but the Swagger declares no security scheme and /search answered without one on 2026-09-24. 429 on too many requests (no threshold published).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: 'Load a job ad by ID' (404 when the ad is gone). description.text is plain text; description.text_formatted, application_details (url/email/via_af) and occupation stay in raw.
